tool_args.rationale: The pilot indicates static snapshots are uninformative and opposing steps matter. The available rows are insufficient to confidently identify the temporal response over the requested forecast horizon, so a fine trajectory batch is the relevant discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the verified single-mode Maxwell law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations do not show a consistent amplitude-decay pattern across horizon, so its temporal scale and adequacy remain uncertain.
The opposing-step responses depend on the input shift, while the authorized OU note specifies dependence on the current snapshot; these rows do not establish it as the right mechanism.
It is explicitly nuisance-only and does not resolve the temporal trajectory ambiguity.
